summary: Keep one Beanfield Metroconnect record. Retain DigitalBridge as active majority owner from November 12, 2019, add OMERS Infrastructure as active minority owner from the September 15, 2023 close, and exclude InfraBridge. Beanfield Technologies Inc. and Beanfield Metroconnect are legal and operating names for the same platform, while OpenFace and Aptum's metro-network assets remain subordinate.
unresolvedDisclosureGaps: The exact DigitalBridge and OMERS ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.
The OMERS fund, investment vehicle and exact Beanfield parent legal name are not publicly disclosed.
Any residual management ownership after the OMERS transaction is not publicly disclosed.
excludedUnsupportedClaims: The returned 2025 securitization statement is not accepted because its supplied generic law-firm URL does not expose that claim.
